bias.zh: 短线偏空 · 自 $98 反弹

read.en: Intel rose 1.4% on Oct 13 to $102.81 after dipping to $98.22 intraday. It stays below its 5-day ($105.8), 10-day ($111.7), 30-day ($108.7) and falling 100-day ($107.9) averages, well above the 200-day ($83.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 but is above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 5 ($119.5), and RSI is 42.
read.zh: 英特尔 10月13日盘中跌至 $98.22 后回升，上涨 1.4% 收于 $102.81。股价仍位于 5 日（$105.8）、10 日（$111.7）、30 日（$108.7）及下行的 100 日均线（$107.9）下方，远高于 200 日均线（$83.7）。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方，但仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月5日起看空（$119.5），RSI 为 42。

read.en: The dip reached the $98.3 June pivot and the stock closed back above $100. Resistance is $104 (former support, $102.4–104.7) and the 5-day average ($105.8), then $108 (30 and 100-day averages) and $114 (Sep 29 swing high). Support is $98.2–98.3, then $94.5 (September low). A close below $98 would open $94.5.
